statement_en: Let $X$ be a topological space and $Y$ a topological group, and suppose they are isomorphic as topological spaces, that is, there exists a homeomorphism $h:Y \to X$. If $f\in C_0(X\to \mathbb{C})$, then $g = f\circ h \in C_0(Y\to \mathbb{C})$.
key_techniques: preservation of continuity under composition with a homeomorphism
preservation of vanishing at infinity under homeomorphism
callout_body: 拓扑空间$X$与拓扑群$Y$同构，即存在一个同胚映射$h:Y \to X$。现在假设$f\in C_0(X\to \mathbb{C})$那么$g = f\circ h \in C_0(Y\to \mathbb{C})$.
